candidate_policy: k=B/query_count, union/deduplicate, add only normally scored EOS; all queries rerank every candidate; never inject gold

comparison.eligible_claim: An ANN path needs both tuning and confirmation fidelity screens; compare its freshly measured complete decode to same-arm exact and display dense/Direct1 quality-cost frontier
comparison.learning_quality: Keep existing exact three-seed learning NLL visible; no new training quality or dense-NLL parity claim
comparison.probability: Report full retained mass separately from R50; candidate-normalized scores never substitute for exact NLL

graph_policy: One newly built graph per arm; reuse across efSearch/budget settings. Record construction cost and output-table fingerprint; no graph-seed robustness claim.

human_authorization.scope: Bounded fixed-checkpoint CPU serving follow-up after Direct4 proposal assessment; no training or GPU execution

limitations: No quantized dense, GPU serving, human generation or convergence claim
question: Can ordinary HNSW search tuning preserve registered own-head fidelity and improve complete CPU decode cost on fixed trained Direct4, with dense and Direct1 controls?

selection.confirmation: Write selection.json before confirmation feature or metric evaluation; no reselection or retuning on confirmation
selection.eligible: Both macro point screens on tuning bank; choose lowest mean cell-median complete cached-decode latency, ties lower B then efSearch
selection.if_none_eligible: Diagnostic only: maximize min(greedy/0.995,R50/0.99), then R50,greedy, then lower latency,B,efSearch; cannot become an eligible win based on confirmation alone

timing.confirmation_secondary: Prefill plus complete decode measured directly
timing.order: Deterministic rotated path order within each request cell, matched own-exact forced continuation per checkpoint
timing.primary: Mean request-cell median complete cached-decode seconds per prediction
